title: 第7章 许配爱女
slug: 九阳剑圣全本免费-九阳剑圣最新章节列表
content_zh:
“稍安勿躁，等我说完。”东方涅灭严厉道。
“是！”阳顶天眼圈一热，泪水几乎要滑落。
“在遗书上我会跟你师娘说，让你成为阴阳宗的下一届宗主，让他倾尽整个阴阳宗的资源去培养你，让你早日成为宇内高手，可以早日掌管整个阴阳宗。”
“另外在遗书中，我还将我的女儿许配给你，她叫东方冰绫，比你小几个月，和你正好是天作之合。她是我唯一的女儿，也是我最最疼爱的掌上明珠，你是一个好孩子，而且也够聪明厉害，将她许配给你我非常放心。”东方涅灭笑道。
“可，可是万一她不答应呢，男女之间要有感情才能在一起的，说不定她已经有心爱的男人了呢？”阳顶天道。
东方涅灭没有说话，拉过阳顶天的手，让他无名指靠近那个火焰挂饰。
顿时，两团火焰猛地从火焰指环位置上冒起，点亮了那个火焰挂饰。火焰挂饰上一个人影渐渐显露出来，印在寒冰墙壁上。
这是一个女孩的影像，一个只有十岁的女孩。尽管只有十岁，却已经绝顶美丽到让人窒息的地步，阳顶天瞬间呼吸一屏，不敢相信还有这么美丽的女孩，这完全是造物主的艺术品。
“这是十年前的小绫儿，也是你的未婚妻。现在十年过去了，她美丽到何等程度，我也无法想象。你的师娘已经是艳绝人寰的绝色，她比你的师娘还要美丽。”东方涅灭道。
确实，阳顶天一辈子见过最美丽的女人就是他的女友李碧君，但是这个东方冰绫却比李碧君还要美丽得多。
“我是她的父亲，我是他的天地，她的一切我说了算，从小到大她最听我的话，我说的任何话他都会听。而且最重要的是她虽然不是九阴之躯，却也是万中无一的纯阴之躯，和她的母亲一样。一般男人哪里有福消受，只有你的九阳之躯才是她最好的绝配。你们两人结成夫妻，地你们各自的修为也有无尽的好处，阴阳调和，完全可以事半功倍。”
“再过三年，她还找不到一个玄脉足够强大的男人交合，她体内阴火到达最旺盛，会痛不欲生，甚至致死。所以，我不把她许配个你我许配个谁？现在，你答应娶我的女儿，你的师妹了吗？”东方涅灭道。
阳顶天面孔一红，然后点了点头。
“哈哈……”东方涅灭道：“这几十年来我唯独今日最高兴，不但找到了一个百年难得一遇的传人，还为我的女儿找到终身的依靠，我真是死而无憾了。”
“十年前我就该死了，却因为不甘护住最后一丝生机期待有奇迹发生，谁知上天真的垂怜于我，将你阳顶天赐予了我。”
看着东方涅灭老朽的面孔涌现不正常的潮红，阳顶天不由得不安道：“师傅。”
“过了足足十年弱不经风的日子，我几乎忘记了当年叱咤风云的我了。”东方涅灭朝阳顶天道：“好徒弟，在这最后的时刻，师傅让你看看真正的我，威武霸气的东方涅灭……”
随着东方涅灭的最后一手，仿佛一股蓝色的火焰猛地从老头身上燃起。顿时，奇迹发生了。
东方涅灭干枯杂乱的头发猛地变得乌黑发亮，飞舞飘扬。他老朽不堪的皮肤，瞬间变得紧绷亮泽。浑浊无神的目光，瞬间变得如同火焰一般灼人亮眼。
瞬间功夫，东方涅灭仿佛年轻了几十岁，从一个灰败的垂垂老朽，变成一个萧疏轩举风姿绝然的中年美男。甚至身上本来如同乞丐装一般的袍子，也瞬间变成了锦衣玉袍，上面的火焰花纹，活灵逼人，仿佛要舔衣而出。

这才是东方涅灭本来的面目，霸气凛然，飘逸不羁。
“我生机太过于微弱，所以这一年来师傅都无法教你一招一式，但是却可以给你一份更加珍贵的礼物，用我最后的力量为你洗髓伐脉。”东方涅灭双手猛地一举，顿时阳顶天身下仿佛有一股热力猛地将他托起，让他整个身体漂浮在半空中。
“修行武道，最重要的就是洗脉。我说人体筋脉如同无数江河小溪，腹中气海如同汪洋，江河小溪的水最后都汇聚奔腾入海。玄气如水，每一次修习都为气海和筋脉增添了一份流水。然而如同这个世界上的江河溪水一样，久而久之就会淤积堵塞，修习进度会越来越慢直到毫无寸进。所以每一次洗髓伐脉都如同疏导通淤，拓宽河道，让筋脉的气流畅通，使得气海与筋脉之间的玄力流动奔腾不起，修习起来事半功倍，一日千里。”

content_en:
"Be patient and wait until I finish speaking." Dongfang Nirvana said sternly.
"Yes!" Yang Dingtian's eyes were filled with tears, and tears almost fell down.
"In my suicide note, I will tell your master wife that you will become the next leader of the Yin Yang Sect, and that he will use all the resources of the Yin Yang Sect to train you so that you can become a master in Yunei and be able to take charge of the entire Yin Yang Sect as soon as possible."
"In addition, in the suicide note, I also betrothed my daughter to you. Her name is Dongfang Bingling. She is a few months younger than you, and she is a perfect match for you. She is my only daughter and my most beloved apple. You are a good child and smart enough. I am very relieved to betroth her to you." Dongfang Niemei smiled.
"But, what if she doesn't agree? A man and a woman must have feelings before they can be together. Maybe she already has a man she loves?" Yang Dingtian said.
Dongfang Nie Mie didn't say anything, but took Yang Dingtian's hand and let his ring finger get close to the flame pendant.
Suddenly, two flames suddenly emerged from the position of the flame ring, lighting up the flame pendant. A figure gradually appeared on the flame hanging ornament, imprinted on the ice wall.
This is an image of a girl, a girl only ten years old. Although she was only ten years old, she was already breathtakingly beautiful. Yang Dingtian took a breath for a moment. He couldn't believe that there was such a beautiful girl. This was completely a work of art from the Creator.
"This is Xiao Ling'er from ten years ago, and she was also your fiancée. Now that ten years have passed, I can't imagine how beautiful she is. Your junior wife is already a stunning beauty, and she is even more beautiful than your junior wife." Dongfang Nirvana said.
Indeed, the most beautiful woman Yang Dingtian has ever seen in his life is his girlfriend Li Bijun, but this Dongfang Bingling is much more beautiful than Li Bijun.
"I am her father, I am his world, I have the final say in everything about her. She has listened to me the most since she was a child, and she will listen to anything I say. And the most important thing is that although she is not a body of nine yins, she is also a pure yin body. Just like her mother. No matter how lucky a man is, only your nine-yang body is the best match for her. If you two become a couple, your respective cultivations will have endless benefits. The harmony of yin and yang can achieve twice the result with half the effort. "
"In another three years, she still won't be able to find a man with strong enough profound veins to have sex with her. The Yin Fire in her body will reach its peak, and she will be in pain and may even die. So, if I don't marry her to you, who will I marry her to? Now, do you agree to marry my daughter, your junior sister?" Dongfang Nirvana said.
Yang Dingtian's face turned red, then he nodded.
"Haha..." Dongfang Niemie said: "In the past few decades, I am the happiest today. Not only did I find a successor that is rare in a century, but I also found a lifelong support for my daughter. I really die without regrets."
"I should have died ten years ago, but because I was unwilling to protect the last glimmer of life, I expected a miracle to happen. Who would have thought that God would take pity on me and give me you, Yang Dingtian."
Seeing the abnormal flush on Dongfang Nirvana's old face, Yang Dingtian couldn't help but said uneasily: "Master."
"After ten years of being weak and helpless, I have almost forgotten the all-powerful me back then." Dongfang Nirvana said to the sky: "Good disciple, at this last moment, master wants you to see the real me, the mighty and domineering Dongfang Nirvana..."
With Dongfang Nirvana's last move, it seemed as if a blue flame suddenly ignited from the old man's body. Suddenly, a miracle happened.
Dongfang Nirvana's dry and messy hair suddenly turned black and shiny, flying and flying. His aging skin instantly became tight and shiny. The dull and dull eyes instantly became as scorching and bright as flames.
In an instant, Dongfang Nirvana seemed to be dozens of years younger, from a dejected old man to a Xiao Shuxuan.A handsome middle-aged man with an absolutely charming appearance. Even the robe on his body, which was originally like a beggar's outfit, instantly turned into a jade robe. The flame patterns on it were so vivid that they seemed to be licking out of the clothes.
This is the true face of Eastern Nirvana, domineering, elegant and uninhibited.
"My vitality is too weak, so the master has not been able to teach you every move this year, but I can give you a more precious gift, using my last strength to cleanse your marrow and cut your veins." Dongfang Nirvana suddenly raised his hands, and suddenly there seemed to be a heat under Yang Dingtian that lifted him up, making his whole body float in the air.
"The most important thing in practicing martial arts is to cleanse the veins. I say that the muscles and veins of the human body are like countless rivers and streams, and the sea of Qi in the belly is like a vast ocean. The water in the rivers and streams eventually gathers and rushes into the sea. The mysterious energy is like water, and every practice adds a flow of water to the sea of Qi and muscles. However, just like the rivers and streams in this world Likewise, over time, it will become blocked, and the progress of practice will become slower and slower until there is no progress at all. Therefore, every time you cleanse the marrow and cut the meridians, it is like clearing the silt, widening the river, allowing the flow of energy in the meridians to flow smoothly, so that the flow of profound energy between the sea of ​​qi and the meridians can no longer run. The practice will get twice the result with half the effort, and make a thousand miles in a day."
